verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an in-product AI Agent with agentic search and question-asking across policies, controls, frameworks, tests, and documents, which also drafts policies and completes questionnaires. Its official hosted MCP server lets assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Perplexity query controls, list failing tests, generate remediation plans, and act on compliance data from natural-language prompts. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation, and clear documentation of how much of the platform the in-product agent can operate by command (beyond search, Q&A, and drafting).
